Built-in installation (preview)
Install with MM Auto only. No Shizuku or King Installer app is needed. This preview uses Android wireless debugging on this phone.

1. Connect your phone to Wi-Fi and enable Developer options → Wireless debugging.\n2. Open MM Auto and Settings side by side using split screen.\n3. In Settings, choose Pair device with pairing code. Keep that window open and enter its six-digit code below. Leave the port empty to find it automatically.
Open phone setup
Pairing port (optional — leave empty for automatic)
Six-digit pairing code
Pair MM Auto
Pairing with this phone…
Checking the connection…
Preparing the app… Downloading it if needed.
Installing the app…
Please wait for the result. Keep MM Auto open.

Return to the main Wireless debugging page. Leave the field empty and tap Check connection. If automatic detection fails, enter the port from “IP address & port”; it is different from the pairing port. MM Auto will connect only to this phone.
Connection port (optional — leave empty for automatic)
Check connection
Check the connection again
Pair again
You may need to enable wireless debugging again after a restart or a Wi-Fi change. Its connection port can change. Pairing is not needed again unless Android forgets MM Auto.
Enter the port number shown by Android (1–65535).
Enter the six-digit code while the pairing window is open.
Ready to reinstall the same version of %1$s. Your app data will be kept.
Ready to download and install %1$s using your selected update channel.
The button below authorizes this installation through the connection you paired. Android may not show another confirmation. Installation does not confirm that the app appears on your car screen.
Install %1$s
You can now turn off wireless debugging in phone settings.
The step did not complete. Check that wireless debugging is on and use the current port. If installation had started, check the installed app before retrying.
The previous step was interrupted. No installation will restart automatically. Check the installed app before choosing to try again.
Review setup and try again
Android completed the installation, but the requested installation source was not confirmed. Check the app on your car screen and share diagnostics if needed.
